representativeSnapshot.kind: Supabase project with promoter Phases 1-8 applied and a verified finance administrator

rowCountQueries: Earned, reversal, and reinstatement ledger entries by event and currency
Existing payout allocation count and amount by commission ledger entry
Open/reviewing high and critical risk flags and latest commission hold action
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: Creates empty payout batch/audit/hold tables and nullable allocation columns. Runtime batch allocation only inserts allocations for eligible, unallocated earned entries.

execution.resumeStrategy: Migration is expand-only. Runtime allocation locks earned entries with SKIP LOCKED and a unique commission_ledger_id allocation constraint, so an idempotent retry safely returns the original batch or selects remaining entries.
execution.idempotency: Batches have an idempotency key and each payout allocation has one unique immutable earned ledger reference. Reversal and reinstatement entries are included in the derived net before allocation; no commission ledger row is updated.

quarantine.strategy: Keep event_promoter_payouts_enabled disabled to halt new allocations. Existing financial evidence, allocation rows, batch events, and hold events remain intact for forward repair.

constraints: Payout batch events and commission hold events reject UPDATE and DELETE
Only service_role can execute allocation, transition, hold, and reconciliation functions
Batch allocation excludes existing allocations, explicit holds, and open/reviewing high or critical risk flags
Confirmation requires a non-empty external settlement reference
indexes: Batch event/status indexes support finance audit and reconciliation views
Hold event index supports latest-hold lookup per commission ledger entry
Allocation batch/status index supports exact settlement drill-down
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Test concurrent allocation attempts, idempotent replay, partial refund before allocation, reversal after allocation, explicit hold/release, high-risk exclusion, failed batch retry, batch confirmation with and without a settlement reference, and cross-organization batch access denial.

recovery.rollback: Disable event_promoter_payouts_enabled. Do not delete any batch, allocation, hold, or audit history.
recovery.forwardFix: Use additive function replacement or a new batch event. Preserve the immutable commission ledger and exact allocation source reference.

queries: Verify grants: no anon/authenticated direct access to batch, batch-event, or hold-event tables
Verify only service_role executes finance payout mutation/reconciliation RPCs and authenticated users execute only their own payout read RPC
Reconcile earned plus reversals/reinstatements to allocations and confirmed paid totals by event, membership, and currency
Verify a held or high-risk commission cannot enter a new payout batch
